lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular spot clusters arranged in vertical columns of 3-5 units, forming a repetitive grid posterior to the branchial area. Centroids exhibit high contrast against the darker flank ground.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Distinct vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the spot columns, forming anchor nodes in a rectangular matrix pattern across the mid-lateral section.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three parallel horizontal ridges are visible on the upper flank, defined by sharp luminance gradients with light-scattering on the superior edge and shadow-casting on the inferior edge.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple Echeneidae (remoras) attached or swimming in close proximity to the ventral-lateral region near the pectoral fin insertion.
